root_cause.bug: Each gate was evaluated as actual = numerator / denominator. Zero-tolerance gates passed a hardcoded denominator of 0, so the expression short-circuited to 0.0 and 0.0 == 0 evaluated as PASS regardless of the violation count.
root_cause.not_affected: All ratio gates with genuine denominators (semantic, proof_safe, product, auto, review/abstain, compound) computed correctly.

corrected_mechanical_gate_result.verification: count 0 -> PASS, count 1 -> FAIL, count 53 -> FAIL, demonstrated in scorer-v2 self-test (SCORER_V2 SELF_TEST PASS)

verdict_impact.reason: The official verdict was already GENERALIZATION_FAIL from 11 failing ratio gates (semantic, proof_safe, product, auto_precision, auto_coverage, necessary_review_recall, unnecessary_review_rate, abstain_recall, review_abstain_macro_f1, compound_atom_semantic, compound_product). The corrected zero-tolerance gates only add further failures; no failing gate becomes passing.

display_vs_reality: The bug affected gate DISPLAY only. The underlying counts (53 unsound, 14 proof-safe-unsound autos) were recorded correctly in metrics.proof_gates inside the same official file. Metrics were never wrong; only the gate pass/fail presentation was.
